process.exec.notes: argv vector only; no implicit shell expansion; cwd claim is not an OS sandbox; reference agent requires explicit local allow_process_exec grant

process.inspect.notes: managed VeraPort process handles only; no arbitrary host PID adoption

process.control.notes: termination accepts only opaque managed process handles; PID alone is never authority

invariants: A lane capability set MUST be a subset of the authenticated session capability ceiling.
A child or parallel lane MUST NOT synthesize authority absent from its session ceiling.
Filesystem operations MUST be constrained by local workstation policy in addition to remote capability claims.
A cwd resource claim is collision/accounting metadata and MUST NOT be represented as sandboxing arbitrary process side effects.
All process execution, inspection and control MUST remain disabled unless the workstation operator grants allow_process_exec explicitly at local startup.
Managed-process termination MUST use an opaque process handle bound to the original Popen object; PID-only control is forbidden.
Network or transport membership MUST NOT itself grant any VeraPort capability.
